headlines.title: Sack Dance Nathan 168.50 – 131.05 Melissa
headlines.detail: The #11 team takes down #4. Nate finally gets to dance.

headlines.title: Cats&Stuff 148.25 – 126.30 Hash Marks Aaron
headlines.detail: Like any good cat, Katie saw something perfect and knocked it right off the table.

headlines.title: Val's Pals — 173.50
headlines.detail: Best score in the league this week, and it wasn't close.

teams.blurb: Still perfect at 3-0 and No. 1 in points. Nobody in this league can catch the Fugitive.
Second in points and cruised past the Dawg's. Things are getting stranger — and scarier — for everyone else.
Week-high 173.50 and a three-spot jump. The hottest team in the league. Val's got pals AND points.
Survived Fran by 4.40 points. Not pretty, but a W is a W, and Cesar will take it.
Up two spots after handing Aaron his first loss. The Cats are 2-1 and purring.
Biggest fall of the week. Unbeaten no more, and those 2-0 vibes lasted exactly one week.
Most points AGAINST in the league. Melissa isn't bad — everyone just saves their best week for her.
Scored 141.80, which wins a lot of weeks. Just not the week you draw Val's buzzsaw. Wrong place, wrong time, Colin.
Lost by 4.40, the closest game of the week. Fran had the recipe — just pulled it out of the oven too early.
FINALLY, a reason to sack dance. Nate drops 168.50 on Melissa for the upset of the week and climbs out of the basement.
Two straight losses. At this point the team name is starting to feel like false advertising.
0-3 and last in points. The Dawg's are all bark, no bite. Greg, the kennel door is open whenever you're ready.
